description: Mercenary Market: prepare (unsigned) putting a mercenary you hold to work in one of YOUR crews: +150 points on the crew's racket plus his perk until he expires (7 days from purchase). Needs a free worker slot and no other merc on the crew. Refused with the reason if you do not hold him, he is expired or already on a crew, or the crew is not yours, full or has a merc. Costs only gas.

contractSet.description: Optional: "v2" (live Games Master v2 contracts) or "legacy" (retired original Season 1 contracts). Only needed if you hold the same id in both; otherwise v2 is tried first, then legacy.

mercId.description: The mercenary token id (my_shop_items lists yours).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_hire_merc
